nights.title: Alabama 3
nights.name: Alabama 3
nights.extract: Alabama 3 is a British musical group founded in Brixton, London, in 1995. Their track "Woke Up This Morning" was used for the opening credits of the TV series The Sopranos. In the United States, the band is known as A3, to avoid legal conflict with the country music band Alabama.

tr.who: Alabama 3, 1995 yılında London'ın Brixton semtinde kurulmuş britanyalı bir müzik grubudur. "Woke Up This Morning" adlı parçası, The Sopranos dizisinin açılış jeneriğinde kullanıldı. Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nde grup, country müzik grubu Alabama ile yasal bir çatışmayı önlemek için A3 olarak biliniyor.

nights.title: MUNA: Gets So Hot Tour
nights.name: Muna
nights.extract: Muna is an American indie pop band consisting of Katie Gavin, Josette Maskin, and Naomi McPherson. They released two studio albums with RCA Records, About U (2017) and Saves the World (2019), before signing with independent label Saddest Factory Records, which released their third studio album, Muna, in June 2022, and Dancing on the Wall in May 2026.
